description: Leading investigative journalism team, conducting in-depth research and producing impactful reports on social, political, and economic issues. Mentoring junior journalists and developing multimedia storytelling strategies.
Covered major news events across India, produced documentary pieces, and contributed to BBC's digital platforms. Developed strong contacts in political and social sectors.
Reported on various beats including politics, society, and business. Developed skills in fast-paced newsroom environment and breaking news coverage.
